slot.In 1347, Florence had more people: You'd hear the city long before you reached its gates.
slot.Florence grew rich from wool: You'd see the little gold coins changing hands at every stall.
slot.In Florence, each shop's wooden shutter: You'd lean on the counter and chat while you waited.
slot.Along the river, newly dyed cloth: You'd want a cloak in every one of those colours.
slot.At the Old Market, children chased: You'd leave with a basket of figs and all the latest news.
slot.Medieval beds were so big: You'd fall asleep to the sound of everyone breathing softly.
slot.In Florentine houses, the kitchen: You'd be glad of the view from up there, though.
slot.Wool combers heated their heavy iron com: You'd be amazed how soft the wool became.
slot.Even the youngest children had jobs: You'd probably stop to splash in the fountain on the way back.
slot.The Florentines wanted the largest churc: You'd tell your grandchildren you saw it begin.
slot.Boccaccio listened to everyone: You'd find him in a corner of the tavern, smiling to himself.
slot.Many Tuscan farmers gave half: You'd see them come back to the hills at dusk with an empty cart.
slot.In summer, rich Florentines escaped: You'd sleep with the shutters open, listening to the crickets.
slot.On summer evenings, boys swam: You'd dip your feet in the cool water if you could.
slot.Italian merchant ships sailed: You'd smell pepper and cinnamon on the warm harbour air.
slot.The spring of 1348 came to Florence: You'd see almond blossom drifting in the gardens.
slot.Some families shut their doors: You'd find the days passing slowly, but calmly.
slot.Every afternoon, in a shady meadow: You'd hear the stories until the shadows grew long.
slot.In the spring of 1349, the looms: You'd feel the whole city slowly breathe again.
slot.Because there were so few workers left: You'd find your work suddenly worth a great deal more.
